channel.title: Herbal Tea (Caffeine Free) – Tea Drop
channel.description: Brewed with Care, Sipped with Joy

item.title: Hibiscus Rose Petal Tea
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: Hibiscus Rose Petal Tea combines vibrant hibiscus flowers with delicate rose petals, creating a visually stunning and flavorful experience. With a tangy, slightly tart flavor and a floral finish, this caffeine-free blend is ideal for hot or iced tea and is rich in antioxidants.

item.title: Golden Turmeric Ginger Blend
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: A blend of turmeric, ginger, and warming spices, this caffeine-free infusion is both invigorating and grounding. Known for its anti-inflammatory properties, turmeric pairs with ginger for a robust and slightly spicy taste. Enjoy as a soothing tea or add steamed milk for a golden latte.

item.title: Chamomile Honey Delight
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: Chamomile Honey Delight combines calming chamomile flowers with a touch of honey essence, creating a comforting, naturally sweet tea. This caffeine-free blend is ideal for winding down in the evening, with soothing properties that promote relaxation and restful sleep.

item.title: Organic Peppermint Bliss
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: Refreshing and caffeine-free, Organic Peppermint Bliss is a pure herbal infusion made from high-quality peppermint leaves. Its invigorating aroma and cool minty flavor provide a natural pick-me-up, perfect for clearing the mind and soothing digestion. Enjoy hot or iced for a refreshing experience.
